nfas.title: Server Infrastructure Plan for School of Engineering ERP System
nfas.purpose: The Department of ADSE seeks approval to design and implement a centralized Server Infrastructure Plan for the School of Engineering's ERP system, serving approx. 2,000 students and faculty across all eight departments.
nfas.description: Infrastructure deployed on Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS, secured through Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Executed with technical support from the department IT Administrator; no external resource person required.
nfas.justification: Replaces fragmented, manual record-keeping with a scalable, reliable, and secure digital system that improves administrative efficiency across the institution.
nfas.sdgs: SDG 4 - Quality Education; SDG 9 - Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
nfas.submitted_by_name: Dr Arul V, Asst. Professor, Dept. of ADSE
nfas.hod_name: Dr Michael Moses T, HOD / Coordinator, Dept. of ADSE
